title: Brand Kits (beta)
summary: Discover the latest features, updates and improvements of Jitter, the fast and simple motion design tool on the web. Try Jitter for free now.
body_markdown:
You can now save your brand’s colors, text styles, and easings to a Brand Kit and reuse them across every file in your workspace. Great for keeping brand colors and typography exact, giving all your animations the same feel with consistent easings, and helping new teammates stay on brand from their first file. Every plan comes with one Brand Kit, and Max, Ultra, and Enterprise users can create multiple kits.


Here’s how you can use Brand Kits:


1. Open a file in your workspace.
2. In the *Design* tab, click a color or a text style, or switch to the *Animate* tab to choose an easing.
3. Click *+* to save the variable to your Brand Kit.
4. Use slash names like *Brand/Primary* or *Neutral/Gray 400* to sort your variables into groups.
5. Find everything you’ve saved in a dedicated folder in your workspace’s folder list.


This is just the beginning of Brand Kits. We’re working on support for more token types (animation presets, components, and more) so your whole brand can live in one place. ✨


## Other improvements


- Bulk font upload: Add multiple fonts to Jitter in one go by dragging and dropping font files, folders, or zip archives.
- Custom frame rates: Specify the exact frame rate you need to match your video project rather than choosing only from presets.
- Quicker timeline navigation: Snap the playhead to animation boundaries and double-click an animation to jump between its end and start.
- Full-length video import: Imported videos are no longer trimmed to your scene’s duration.
